import jax.numpy as jnp

def angle_loss(y, x, active, weight):
    # Mask before atan2 so its derivative never sees an inactive singularity.
    safe_y = jnp.where(active, y, 0)
    safe_x = jnp.where(active, x, 1)
    safe_weight = jnp.where(active, weight, 0)
    return (safe_weight * jnp.arctan2(safe_y, safe_x)).sum()
